measures.label: Medi-Cal members who received county mental health services (penetration rate)
measures.note: DHCS Behavioral Health Public County Profile Overview file (published July 2026). Sutter and Yuba are listed separately in this file with identical penetration rates, which reflect the combined Sutter-Yuba behavioral health county. DHCS publishes no statewide row in this file. DHCS field dictionary: the percentage of Medi-Cal enrolled individuals who received county mental health services during calendar year 2024. Medi-Cal managed care plans DHCS lists for each county: Butte: Partnership Health Plan of California; Colusa: Partnership Health Plan of California; Del Norte: Partnership Health Plan of California; Glenn: Partnership Health Plan of California; Humboldt: Partnership Health Plan of California; Lake: Partnership Health Plan of California; Mendocino: Partnership Health Plan of California; Shasta: Partnership Health Plan of California; Tehama: Partnership Health Plan of California; Trinity: Partnership Health Plan of California; Siskiyou: Partnership Health Plan of California; Los Angeles: Health Net Community Solutions, L.A. Care Health Plan, Kaiser Permanente, SCAN Health Plan, AIDS Healthcare Foundation; San Bernardino: Molina Healthcare of California, Inland Empire Health Plan, Kaiser Permanente; Sonoma: Kaiser Permanente, Partnership Health Plan of California; Marin: Kaiser Permanente, Partnership Health Plan of California; Sutter: Partnership Health Plan of California, Kaiser Permanente; Napa: Partnership Health Plan of California, Kaiser Permanente.
